name: Jacob
summary: The younger twin of Esau, who took his brother's blessing and fled to his uncle Laban. God renamed him Israel, and his twelve sons became the twelve tribes of Israel.

key_moments.title: Tricks His Father into Blessing Him
key_moments.description: Following his mother's plan, Jacob wore Esau's clothes and goatskins and brought his blind father food. Isaac did not recognize him, and blessed him.

key_moments.title: Dreams of a Ladder to Heaven
key_moments.description: On his way to Haran, Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven with angels going up and down on it. The LORD promised him the land and said He would be with him, and Jacob named the place Bethel.

key_moments.title: Serves Fourteen Years for Rachel
key_moments.description: Jacob worked seven years for Laban's daughter Rachel, whom he loved, but Laban gave him Leah first. Jacob married Rachel too, and served seven more years for her.

key_moments.title: Wrestling Until Daybreak
key_moments.description: Jacob wrestled with a man until daybreak and would not let go without a blessing. He was renamed Israel, and he called the place Peniel, because he had seen God and his life was spared.

key_moments.title: Going Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: His sons told Jacob that Joseph was alive and ruled over Egypt, and his spirit came back to life. At Beersheba God told him not to fear, and Jacob went down to Egypt with all his family.
